title: King Solomon the wise ruler
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child narrates 1 Kings 3:16-28: two women claim one baby, Solomon calls for a sword, the real mother gives up her claim to save the child, the other says "cut him", Solomon gives the baby to the real mother; wisdom comes from God.

floor.prerequisite: Knows wisdom begins with honouring God.
floor.question: Where does wisdom begin, according to Proverbs 1:7?
floor.answer: With the fear of the Lord

representations: two women and a baby drawn
steps: The real mother says "give her the child".
Solomon gives the baby to her.
contexts: a teacher settling a quarrel fairly
a chief hearing a land case

board.do: Draw two speech bubbles for the two women.
Point at the bubble "Give her the living child".
Wait for the child to say the real mother, out of love.

misconceptions.ask: Which woman did Solomon decide was the real mother?
misconceptions.repair: Reread 1 Kings 3:26-27 and ask who loved the child.

listen_for: Solomon had him cut in two
misconceptions.repair: Read verse 27: "Give her the living child".

misconceptions.ask: What does Proverbs 9:10 say is the beginning of wisdom?
misconceptions.repair: Read Proverbs 9:10 and ask what Solomon asked from God in 1 Kings 3:9.

misconceptions.ask: What did Solomon ask God for (1 Kings 3:9)?
misconceptions.repair: Read 1 Kings 3:9-11: God was pleased because Solomon did not ask for riches.

checks.question: Which woman was the real mother?
checks.answer: The one who said "Give her the living child"

checks.question: Was the baby cut in two?
checks.answer: No: he was given alive to his mother
